stories.title: Verkeer Suurhoffbrug tot acht weken over vluchtstrook door scheuren in constructie

en.title: Suurhoffbrug A15 traffic diverted to emergency lane for six to eight weeks due to structural cracks
en.summary: Traffic on the A15 toward Maasvlakte will use the emergency lane for six to eight weeks after cracks were found in the main supports of the western Suurhoffbrug. The 1974-built section has been closed to regular traffic due to safety concerns.

stories.title: Verkeer A15 moet zeker maand over vluchtstrook vanwege scheuren in brug

en.title: A15 traffic must use emergency lane for at least one month due to bridge damage
en.summary: Traffic on the A15 toward Maasvlakte will use the emergency lane for four to eight weeks following the discovery of cracks in the western Suurhoffbrug.

stories.title: NASA ontdekt nieuwe krater op de maan die groter is dan het Colosseum

en.title: NASA discovers new crater on the moon larger than the Colosseum
en.summary: NASA scientists found a lunar crater exceeding the size of Rome's Colosseum, created by a powerful impact that occurred two years ago and went initially undetected.

stories.title: Toch bezwaar bij 'geen bezwaar': nieuwe wet levert weinig extra orgaandonaties op

en.title: New organ donation law yields little increase in donations despite 'no objection' default
en.summary: A 2021 law change setting organ donation as the default unless citizens object has produced minimal additional donations. In 59 percent of cases with no objection registered, donation still does not occur after death.

stories.title: Zonder Henk Kroes had de rest van Nederland nooit geweten wat ‘it giet oan’ betekent

en.title: Without Henk Kroes, the rest of the Netherlands would never have known what 'it giet oan' means
en.summary: A cultural figure named Henk Kroes is credited with introducing a Frisian phrase to wider Dutch awareness.

stories.title: Nieuwe grote krater op de maan ontdekt: 'Gebeurt misschien eens in de eeuw'

en.title: New large crater on the moon discovered: 'Perhaps happens once a century'
en.summary: NASA identified a newly formed lunar crater measuring 221 meters wide and 41 meters deep using images from an orbiting spacecraft. Such impact events occur very infrequently, according to the space agency.

stories.title: Steeds meer mensen werken niet, terwijl groep werkenden niet groeit

en.title: Increasingly more people are not working, while the group of working people does not grow
en.summary: Statistics show the number of non-working people is increasing while the employed workforce remains unchanged, placing greater strain on the welfare system.

stories.title: Tijdens de welvaartsexplosie van de 17de eeuw kochten steeds meer mensen een lapje grond

en.title: During the prosperity explosion of the 17th century, increasingly more people bought a piece of land
en.summary: Researchers examine how economic growth affected property ownership and inequality during the Dutch Golden Age of the 1600s.

stories.title: Nieuwe donorwet levert beperkt aantal extra donoren op: ‘Categorie ‘geen bezwaar’ blijft uitdagend’

en.title: New donor law yields limited number of additional donors: 'Category of no objection remains challenging'
en.summary: A new donor law in the Netherlands has resulted in only a modest increase in organ donors. The category of people with no objection to donation continues to present difficulties.

stories.title: Huis van Afgevaardigden VS keurt sanctiepakket tegen Rusland goed

en.title: US House of Representatives approves sanctions package against Russia
en.summary: The US House of Representatives has approved a sanctions package targeting Russia. The measure represents legislative action on US-Russia relations.

stories.title: Ook Amerikaans lagerhuis stemt in met omvangrijk sanctiepakket tegen Rusland

en.title: US House of Representatives approves comprehensive sanctions package against Russia
en.summary: The US House of Representatives approved a major sanctions package against Russia designed to limit Russian funding for the Ukraine war. The Senate had previously agreed to the measure, and it now awaits President Trump's signature.

stories.title: Nederland zakt verder weg op wereldwijde ranglijst voor gendergelijkheid

en.title: Netherlands declines further on global gender equality ranking
en.summary: The Netherlands has dropped to 46th place on the global gender equality index from 43rd place the previous year. Women's emancipation has stalled in the country as other nations make progress.
